title: From Industrial Product Documentation to Automated Digital Product Passport Generation: An Experimental Study of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manufacturing companies that are planning to sell certain products in the European Union (EU) will be required to provide mandatory digital product passports (DPPs). The use of DPPs is to provide standardized product information throughout multiple product life cycles in a circular economy. Required passport information, such as technical specifications, material composition, and environmental product footprint, is available in manufacturers' data sources but is scattered across different heterogeneous systems, documents, and data formats. The given paper investigates using large language models (LLMs) to automate the generation of DPPs based on the asset administration shell (AAS). A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach is used to extract product information from industrial documentation and generate populated AAS instances. translated_title: 从工业产品文档到自动化数字产品护照生成：大语言模型的实验研究
translated_abstract: 计划在欧盟（EU）销售特定产品的制造企业将被要求提供强制性的数字产品护照（DPP）。数字产品护照旨在循环经济中为产品的多个生命周期提供标准化的产品信息。所需的护照信息，如技术规格、材料成分和环境产品足迹，虽然存在于制造商的数据源中，但分散在不同的异构系统、文档和数据格式之中。本文研究了利用大语言模型（LLM）基于资产管理壳（AAS）自动生成数字产品护照的方法。该研究采用检索增强生成（RAG）方法，从工业文档中提取产品信息并生成填充完成的AAS实例。产品文档经过处理后被分割为文本块，随后这些文本块被存储在持久化的向量数据库中（注：原摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）与大语言模型的方法，从分散异构的工业产品文档中自动提取产品信息，并依据资产管理壳（AAS）标准自动生成符合欧盟要求的数字产品护照（DPP）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach leveraging large language models to automatically extract product information from scattered heterogeneous industrial documentation and generate EU-compliant digital product passports (DPPs) based on the Asset Administration Shell (AAS) standard.
